fields.description: Name of the field this region yields, e.g. `MPN`, `Lot`, `Qty`. Free-form — the consuming app decides which keys it expects.
fields.label: Field Key

fields.description: `Text` reads the region with the OCR engine; `Barcode` decodes any barcode inside the region with zxing-cpp.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Left edge as a fraction (0–1) of the reference image width.
fields.label: X

fields.description: Top edge as a fraction (0–1) of the reference image height.
fields.label: Y

fields.description: Width as a fraction (0–1) of the reference image width.
fields.label: W

fields.description: Height as a fraction (0–1) of the reference image height.
fields.label: H

fields.description: Optional. Restrict the decode to a barcode symbology, e.g. `Code128`, `DataMatrix`, `QRCode`. Blank accepts any.
fields.label: Barcode Format

fields.description: Optional. Applied to the recognized value; if it has a capture group, group 1 is used, else the whole match. Lets a region trim label chrome (e.g. strip a `P/N:` prefix).
fields.label: Extract Regex
